Set the maximum number of frames between two keyframes. This maps to FFmpeg's `-g` option. Default: Let the encoder decide.

## CLI flag

```text
--gop <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#gopsize)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#gopsize)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#gopsize)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#gopsize)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setGopSize(239);
```
